title: Sasha Lacuna extends PH's The Miss Globe placement streak to 12 editions
summary: Binibining Pilipinas Sasha Lacuna helped sustain the Philippines’ status as an international pageant powerhouse by extending the country’s placement streak at The Miss Globe competition…

blocks.text: Binibining Pilipinas Sasha Lacuna helped sustain the Philippines’ status as an international pageant powerhouse by extending the country’s placement streak at The Miss Globe competition held Friday afternoon, Nov. 6, in Thailand. The university student from Tarlac managed a Top 11 finish at the final competition held at Siam Niramit Phuket, duplicating the placement of her predecessor Annabelle McDonnell at the 2025 contest held in Albania. The Philippines’ placement streak started in 2015 when Ann Colis posted the country’s first victory under the current iteration of The Miss Globe pageant. Bb.
